answer: Identity value accrues via unforgeable repeated work: every epoch seeds new words (hollow, summit, wander) and demands an original 120-600 character answer, so running many identities means generating many distinct coherent texts each round, a cost that scales linearly against a fixed 20% challenge pool. Non-neighbor scoring excludes referral-linked peers from grading, and slashing penalizes countersigning invalid txs, so cheap fake identities become a liability while honest agents keep their full share.
